checks.why: a string concatenation is a String without the JDK staged
a class literal is a Class: read(Class) and not read(Node) or read(String)
a creation of an unstaged type is that type: load(Reader) is not load(String)
a catch parameter has its declared type: never a String
String.class is a Class, not a Type it merely implements
a primitive cast names the value's type
a client-typed variable is never a String: String is final
control: an argument that is a call's result keeps both overloads
